title: Interview. Bill Nygren on 25 Years of Beating the Market

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this incredible interview I spoke with legendary investor Bill Nygren.
reader_summary.overview: In this incredible interview I spoke with legendary investor Bill Nygren, who has beaten the market over a 25 year period by around 200bps. This is an extremely hard and rare feat. In our wide-spanning conversation Bill tells us about everything from his investment process and valuation framework to how to value a cyclical business.

key_points.text: In our wide-spanning conversation Bill tells us about everything from his investment process and valuation framework to how to value a cyclical business.
We even had time to talk about his Salesforce and Airbnb postions a bit.
